description: Return the audience profile of a project: monthly visits averaged over the last twelve months, unique visitors, deduplicated audience, annual visits, month-over-month change, visit duration, pages per visit, bounce rate, device split and the top countries with their shares and changes. Before a project is revealed the figures come as bands and the global, country and industry ranks are withheld, because a rank identifies the site outright; after a reveal the ranks are included, and precision: exact returns exact values instead of bands. Costs the base price plus the audience price for every project whose audience your organization does not already hold, and with precision: exact a surcharge for every revealed project on every call; a project without an audience layer comes back with profile null and is charged neither the part nor the exact surcharge. Ask in bands first, and for exact values only when your user needs exact numbers.

estimate.description: When true, run the query but return only its composition, price and a quote_token instead of data

precision.description: band (default) or exact; exact applies only to revealed projects, adds a surcharge for each of them, and is otherwise ignored with a note

quote_token.description: Execute a previous estimate: pass the quote_token instead of the query parameters

refs.description: Projects to describe; refused above batch.get_audience in capabilities; required unless quote_token is given

items.description: Opaque project id as returned by this server to your organization

name: get_audience
title: Audience profile
